warning[ZBX-W0201]: mapping only your own id into the container
  while  choosing the container's id map
  cause  the container will map only its root, to your own id; other ids will
         not exist inside it
  cause  alice (uid 1000); no subuid range of 65536 ids (largest: 0); no subgid
         range of 65536 ids (largest: 0); newuidmap not found; newgidmap not
         found
  fix    give this user id ranges:    sudo usermod --add-subuids 100000-165535 --add-subgids 100000-165535 $(id -un)
         install on Debian, Ubuntu:   sudo apt install uidmap
         install on Fedora:           sudo dnf install shadow-utils
  more   zbx explain W0201
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/W0201.html
